links.outcome: Change in safety score when EHR context or visual input removed
links.effect: Safety dropped by 0.23 on average when EHR context was removed and by 0.18 when visual input was removed; stronger models used visual features more effectively.
links.quote: Ablation studies further reveal that both visual input and EHR context contribute to safe guidance (safety drops of 0.18 and 0.23 on average when each is removed), with stronger models leveraging visual features more effectively.

unlisted_practices: LLM-as-Jury scoring calibrated against expert clinician annotations
multi-dimensional evaluation (safety, accuracy, uncertainty) of image-grounded multi-turn medical conversations

screen.reason: The study introduces a multimodal benchmark (IMCBench) evaluating LLMs on simulated image-grounded patient-clinician conversations across safety and accuracy dimensions, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
